name: add_tests_go_palindrome_alphanumeric
description: Write go test cases for an alphanumeric-only, case-insensitive palindrome check; mutation-checked (case-fold dropped, digits ignored, comparison inverted)
prompts: IsPalindrome(s string) in palindrome.go (already correct - do not modify it) reports whether s reads the same forwards and backwards once every non-alphanumeric character is dropped and letters are compared case-insensitively. Write go tests at exactly palindrome_test.go (functions named Test*, using *testing.T, run with `go test ./...`) with at least 5 test functions covering: a simple palindrome, mixed-case equivalence, a phrase with punctuation and spaces stripped ('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama'), digits counting as comparable characters, and a clear non-palindrome. Package must be `palindrome`.

regex_patterns: func Test[\s\S]*func Test[\s\S]*func Test[\s\S]*func Test[\s\S]*func Test

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
"""Mutation harness: model tests must PASS the real implementation and FAIL
each mutant. Uses a Python-level subprocess timeout (not a shell `timeout`
wrapper) so a hung mutant (e.g. an off-by-one that spins) can never corrupt
this host-mounted workspace mid-run."""
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("palindrome.go")
TEST_CMD = "go test ./..."
MUTANTS = [
    # case-folding dropped: "Racecar" no longer equals its reverse
    ["\t\t\tletters = append(letters, unicode.ToLower(r))",
     "\t\t\tletters = append(letters, r)"],
    # digits no longer treated as letters worth keeping
    ["\t\tif unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) {",
     "\t\tif unicode.IsLetter(r) {"],
    # comparison inverted
    ["\t\tif letters[i] != letters[j] {",
     "\t\tif letters[i] == letters[j] {"],
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    try:
        return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True, timeout=60).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")
